resolution.note: Stable roadmap ids, no Rank column; lanes never edit the roadmap; lead prunes closed rows with scripts/claude/roadmap-prune.ts; replay test proves separate removals merge and positional renumbering conflicts.

title: Let parallel lanes close roadmap rows without merge conflicts
body:
Outcome: parallel lanes that close roadmap tasks merge without rebasing docs/program/roadmap.md onto each other.
Why: on 2026-11-09 three lanes each deleted their row and renumbered the rest; #490 was rebased twice and #492 once for roadmap conflicts alone, and one lane deleted the wrong row (R1 instead of R2) in a rebase. Positional ids (renumber on every removal) make every row deletion touch every later line.
Proof: the roadmap test drops the renumbering requirement (stable ids, rank column sorted but gaps allowed) or the row of a closed task is pruned mechanically after merge; two branches each removing a different row merge cleanly in a test or a replay.
Scope: docs/program/roadmap.md, test/rules/roadmap-open-tasks.test.ts, scripts/claude/handoff-requests.ts.
